CS sizes, purity, representatives and entropy resolution describe original fits, without redefining their formal CS
CS-to-CS: overlap OR CS overlap OR representative LD; CS-to-unretained: posterior overlap only, unresolved
All active components plus formal CS boundary cases; diffuse overlap is descriptive, not a confirmed split/merge
Continuous entropy effective-candidate count and fraction; no calibrated binary diffuse threshold
Union of formal CS members, requested top candidates and PIP-threshold candidates
Baseline first; greedy one-to-one formal-CS aid is not evidence of unique signal identity
